name: Environment fixture
promise: Every section in one column, styled only by the environment a preview sets.
description: The preview's environment fixture (#7, Slice 4). It renders every section through the kit's shared renderers and styles only against the environment attributes on its boundary: the display mode, contrast, motion, and enhancement, with system colors and the system font stack. A mark that moves shows motion, and an enhancement shows the page's scripts ran. It registers only when PREVIEW_FIXTURES=1.
